meta.name: atlas-map
meta.description: Map the system architecture — read the codebase, identify services and connections, output a C4-level architecture map as Mermaid diagrams with component descriptions. Use when asked to "map the architecture", "system diagram", "how does this work", or "architecture overview".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为 C4 架构图与组件说明
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想快速理解陌生代码库的整体架构。
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into C4 architecture diagrams with component descriptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly understand the overall architecture of an unfamiliar codebase.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你的代码库，识别出各个服务、模块和数据存储，然后生成 C4 级别的架构图（Mermaid 格式）和组件描述，保存在项目文档中。
howto.when: 当你主动要求“画架构图”、“系统图”、“解释系统如何工作”或“架构概览”时触发。

say.text: 画出这个项目的系统架构图。
告诉我这个系统是怎么工作的。
say.note: Claude 会输出架构图和服务描述。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude analyzes your codebase, identifies services, modules, and data stores, then generates C4-level architecture diagrams in Mermaid format and component descriptions, saving them to project docs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask to "map the architecture", "system diagram", "how does this work", or "architecture overview".

say_en.text: Draw the system architecture diagram of this project.
say_en.note: Claude scans the code and produces C4 Level 1 and 2 Mermaid diagrams.
Claude outputs the architecture map and service descriptions.
